title: Concept: Apache Zeppelin console is reachable without authentication
description: Zeppelin is a code execution surface: each paragraph runs in an interpreter bound to the cluster, and the default deployment ships with the anonymous role enabled. Reaching it is close to reaching a shell on a cluster node.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller runs code with the privileges of the notebook server, reads every notebook, and pivots to the cluster the interpreters are bound to.
